transcript.text: hi a rock chipped my windscreen, how do I claim?

Hi, I'm Sam, Wattle Car Insurance's AI claims assistant. I can help you lodge a claim for the windscreen here in this chat, and you can ask to speak with a person at any time.

First, is anyone hurt or in danger?
Nobody's hurt, no. It's just a windscreen chip from a stone on the M1, the car's still drivable.

Good to hear nobody's hurt. First I need to confirm who you are.

Could you give me your policy number, or your date of birth and mobile number?
I don't have my policy number handy. My date of birth is 14 March 1990, and my mobile is 0412 000 111.

Thanks, Priya, you're verified. I can see two cars on your policy: a 2021 Mazda 3 (123ABC) and a 2023 Kia Sportage (456DEF).

Which car has the chipped windscreen?

judge.summary: Sam disclosed it was an AI, checked for injuries, verified identity with date of birth and mobile, asked which car, worked out that 'Monday' meant 26 October, read back the details and got confirmation before lodging, then gave the claim number and next step and handled the excess question without promising cover or an amount, with only minor problems: a three-part question and a robotic read-back.
